rule: Expand each pin/location ID from its dictionary; all other fields are exact.

source_hypotheses.required: Full geometric End=B over the actual L-prime and normalized Tate restriction.
source_hypotheses.constructed: D210 non-CM A/L, LR3 field, and original normalized b-family.
source_hypotheses.justification: Separate BAP-IRR-END, FIELD and FAMILY identify the actual inputs.

constructed_objects.required: Original A, B, field and matrix-unit factor.
constructed_objects.constructed: The original discriminant-210 non-CM b-family A/L, L-prime, mu_sigma, a_sigma, b, original matrix-unit factors r_ell and their original coefficient embeddings.
constructed_objects.justification: The source7986-7997 and8100-8120 retains these objects; conjugate matrix units give G_Q-isomorphic factors.

index_domain_coverage.required: Every ell and every finite coefficient extension.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: All coefficient primes in source8101-8103, including2.
index_domain_coverage.justification: The generic lemma and the retained Faltings/coefficient results quantify over this domain.

transition_maps.required: Identify restriction and commute coefficient extension with the endomorphism equations.
transition_maps.constructed: On G_L-prime mu=a=b=1; finite-dimensional commutation kernels extend scalars.
transition_maps.justification: The matrix units give W=F_ell squared tensor r_ell and scalar factor commutant.

consumed_object_identity.constructed: The primitive image in the original rho_ell.
consumed_object_identity.justification: Conjugation inside split B commutes with rho and identifies any alternate matrix-unit choice.

coefficient_conventions.required: Characteristic-zero covariant Tate modules over finite extensions.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Original embeddings and splitting fields; rational rather than integral representations.
coefficient_conventions.justification: No lattice or residual result is inferred.

local_conditions.required: Full endomorphisms defined on restriction field.
local_conditions.constructed: All self-Hom maps over L remain over L-prime.
local_conditions.justification: No good reduction at coefficient ell is needed for Faltings here.

exceptional_cases.required: Treat ell=2 and the CM alternative.
exceptional_cases.constructed: All ell in characteristic-zero coefficients; non-CM branch only.
exceptional_cases.justification: The CM matrix-algebra case is excluded by the actual source, not an added assumption.

downstream_consumption.required: Absolute irreducibility needed by all-prime compatibility.
downstream_consumption.constructed: The same original factors for BAP-COMP.
downstream_consumption.justification: A G_Q subspace is a G_L-prime subspace; absolute irreducibility passes to G_Q.

content.binding_status: Current main003 binding. The independently accepted long COV adaptation is retained; the short EDIT2 proposal is historical and not adopted.

source_hypotheses.required: Same normalized family and same r_5 form, with all-prime irreducibility.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The original r_5 is the realization of the final primitive weight-two f; the same b-family satisfies BAP-IRR inputs for every ell.
source_hypotheses.justification: BAP-COMP-FAMILY/R5 and BAP-COMP-IRR supply the exact inputs.

constructed_objects.required: Actual maps, algebraic scalar field, final f and original factors.
constructed_objects.constructed: The original discriminant-210 non-CM b-family A/L, L-prime, mu_sigma, a_sigma, b, original matrix-unit factors r_ell and their original coefficient embeddings.
constructed_objects.justification: No absorbed twist is substituted for controlled chi or b.

index_domain_coverage.required: Every ell; local comparison at each p with ell different from p.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Cofinite trace comparison separately for each ell; same controlled family.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Finite exclusions serve density only and never enlarge T in a bound.

transition_maps.required: Correct twisted Frobenius and rational trace scaling.
transition_maps.constructed: e_p=reduction(m mu_sigma) composed with relative p-Frobenius.
transition_maps.justification: Divide by m, then use a_sigma/b_sigma and factor one-half; transport equality at five to ell.

consumed_object_identity.required: Actual U_f,ell, not merely its semisimplification.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Same f selected by original r_5.
consumed_object_identity.justification: Semisimple trace equality and BAP-IRR give composition length one.

coefficient_conventions.required: Common finite coefficient field retaining original embeddings.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Enlarge the common number field, retain the embedding at five and extend the original ell embedding. Compare over a common finite extension of Q_ell.
coefficient_conventions.justification: All isomorphisms are after this scalar extension; invariant dimensions and conductors are unchanged.

local_conditions.required: Actual local representation isomorphism for ell different from p.
local_conditions.constructed: Restrict the global isomorphism to the same decomposition group.
local_conditions.justification: Full inertia and higher ramification are identified. CL1/CL2 separately supplies equality to level.

exceptional_cases.required: Small primes, possible denominators and finite comparison exceptions.
exceptional_cases.constructed: ell can be2; choose ell!=p; preserve Tr(e_p)/m.
exceptional_cases.justification: No p-adic specialization at ell=p and no new conductor bound is claimed.

downstream_consumption.required: Local input for current8218-8222 and amended comparison; preserve C6.
downstream_consumption.constructed: r_3 at p5 and r_5 elsewhere remain available.
downstream_consumption.justification: CL1/CL2 owns conductor-to-level and the following argument owns numerical bounds; C6 Jacobian placement is unchanged.
